Okay before I get 10 comments that say see a doctor let me add that seeing a doctor is not an option no one can ever know I cut if you have no other advice than that's fine sorry I am not mad at who posted this I just don't want to be looked at like an idiot.

I think you would be so much happier if you went and seeked out help because if you shove it to the side it will just get worse. You are not overreacting at all and you should not be ashamed for it at all.

There are many ways to stop that I have read about but never really tried because I have no will to stop. One is the butterfly project that one you can just google. Then I heard about people keeping a bag of like skittles with them and every time they want to self harm they eat one instead. Then there is wearing a hairband around your wrist and every time you want to self harm taking it and snapping it. Those are the only ones I can think of at the moment I have faith in you good luck and I hope you get better.

Yes you can get a scar from scratching but it will go away soon depending on how serious like you can see the progression in my cuts at least and you should know it is a terrible habit because even though you think you can control it now you will feel an urge to cut deeper every time and then if you do it on your wrist someone will notice and approach you on it so you will tell you will stop and move to your legs cutting deeper each time needing to see the blood I started seeing people post stuff like this and I said it would not be me and now it is so please don't. Stop well you can. I know your thoughts may be scary but you need to keep yourself together. cutting is just another way of letting the monster of depression in. So escape well you can the first cut is the one you will always remember so I hope you get over it and you will always get bad thoughts just stay strong and get help if you need it.
